name: Michio Kaku
summary: Michio Kaku is a theoretical physicist and science communicator known for explaining advanced physics to general audiences.

facts.text: Kaku has written popular science books that explain physics ideas such as parallel worlds, the future of technology, and the universe.
facts.context: His public work shows how difficult ideas can become inviting when they are connected to imagination and everyday curiosity.
